results.summary: This project implements 18 programmable digital LIF neurons with programmable delays and 144 synapses arranged in three fully connected layers. Input spikes are weighted and accumulated into membrane potentials, with weights, thresholds, decay, refractory periods, and delays programmable over SPI. Internal membrane potentials or output spikes can be read through SPI selection. The design is implemented in Verilog and is not reported as tested on silicon.

results.summary: This design implements a phase frequency detector and a zero dead zone PFD. The basic PFD drives UP high when the VCO input leads and DN high when the reference input leads. A second PFD block provides additional UP2, DN2, and Reset outputs. The design is implemented in Wokwi and is not reported as tested on silicon.
